comment: Kerberos authentication policies, authentication policy silos and device group synchronisation for the Tier Model. Optional add-on - deployed by Deploy-TierModel.ps1 -AuthSilosOnly and as the last phase of -FullDeployment when this file has entries. Requires a domain functional level of Windows Server 2012 R2 or later. Keep enforce=false (audit mode) until the AuthenticationPolicyFailures event logs are clean. See docs/authentication-silos.md.

authenticationPolicies.name: Tier 0 Authentication Policy
authenticationPolicies.description: Tier 0 accounts may only sign in from domain controllers, Tier 0 PAW devices and Tier 0 member servers
authenticationPolicies.comment: Replaces '*- Tier 0 Authentication Silo' of optional/TierModel-AuthSilos. Device condition: DC OR member of any device group.

authenticationPolicies.name: Tier 1 Authentication Policy
authenticationPolicies.description: Tier 1 accounts may only sign in from Tier 1 PAW devices and Tier 1 member servers
authenticationPolicies.comment: Replaces '*- Tier 1 Authentication Silo' of optional/TierModel-AuthSilos. Device condition: member of any device group.

authenticationPolicySilos.name: Tier 0 Authentication Silo
authenticationPolicySilos.comment: All users below the Tier 0 Accounts OU are permitted in and assigned to the silo. Service accounts (Tier 0 Service Accounts OU) are not included.

authenticationPolicySilos.name: Tier 1 Authentication Silo
authenticationPolicySilos.comment: All users below the Tier 1 Accounts OU are permitted in and assigned to the silo. Service accounts (Tier 1 Service Accounts OU) are not included.
